Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff

Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. New AIDS guidelines counteract hysteria 2. United States Supreme Court reviews sodomy statutes 3. Gay Anti-Defamation League holds first meeting in New York City, includes clip of Vito Russo speech 4. What the Gay Cable Network is thankful for 5. Drug Abuse Resistance Education funds Independent AIDS researchers 6. Carol Burnett speaks out in public announcements, American Foundation for AIDS Research 7. New York City Council Health Committee hearing coverage, David Rothenberg speaks 8. FBI and Rock Hudson 9. Richard Feldman, Attorney discusses lack of gay rights and housing in the New York City area COMMERCIAL: "New York Native" with Quentin Crisp 10. Sports, including Bart Conner clip 11. Healthline: Conversations with GMHC: Lori Behrman, Director of Public Information for GMHC, discusses media and presentation 12. Closing credits
The Right Stuff: 1. John Burke, footage of Sybil Bruncheon and Bill Baumer at Halloween parade, Christopher Street COMMERCIAL: The Monster 2. Eye on New York COMMERCIAL: AIDS hotline, New York AIDS Action 3. "Sounds in the Distance," includes clips
